Question Paper  
Exam Date & Time: 24-Nov-2025 (02:00 PM - 05:00 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  FIFTH SEMESTER B.TECH. DEGREE EXAMINATIONS - NOVEMBER 2025  
  SUBJECT: ECE 3123/ECE_3123 COMMUNICATION NETWORKS  
  (SPL: ELECTRONICS & COMMUNICATION ENGINEERING)  
  COMMUNICATION NETWORKS [ECE 3123]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                      Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1A)               For the generator polynomial 110011 and the data bits 11100011, find the CRC and the transmitted (4)  
  string.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
1B)               Four channels, two with a bit rate of 200kbps and two with a bit rate of 150 kbps, are to be          (3)  
  multiplexed using multiple slots TDM with no synchronization bits. Find: i) Frame size ii) Frame rate  
  iii) Data rate.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Evaluate"  
  
1C)               Represent the bit stream 11010100 using the following line encoding techniques: i) Manchester ii)        (3)  
  Differential Manchester iii) RZ iv) NRZ-I v) NRZ vi) Bipolar  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
2A)               Draw the flow diagram of CSMA/CA and explain its features.                                               (4)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
2B)               Illustrate a priority-based token ring with suitable example.                                            (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
2C)               In a 10 Base5 cable, find:                                                                            (3)  
  i) Time taken by a bit to travel from the beginning to the end of the network. Ignore any propagation  
  delay in the equipment.  
  ii) Maximum time it takes for a sender to detect a collision.  
  iii) Minimum size of an Ethernet frame for collision detection.  
  iv) The bit length in the medium.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Evaluate"  
  
3A)               If the IPv4 packet is received with the following header, verify for errors if any, using an appropriate (4)  
  error control technique.  
  
  
  Page #1

Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Evaluate"  
  
3B)   Use Dijkstra's algorithm to find the shortest distance between nodes 's' and 't'.                     (3)  
  
  
  NOTE: Tabulate the routing updates.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Evaluate"  
  
3C)   Discuss the congestion prevention policies at network layer and transport layer.                      (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
4A)   Form routing table at Node A, before and after link breaks between A and E using Bellman-Ford         (4)  
  routing algorithm.  
  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
4B)   MAHE is granted with a block of addresses and one of the addresses is 160.124.228.200/19.             (3)  
  MAHE needs to allocate these addresses to its three Institutes Engineering, Management, and  
  Medical as follows:  
  i) Engineering has 24 departments and each department needs 115 addresses  
  ii) Management has 20 departments and each department needs 56 addresses  
  iii) Medical has 10 departments and each needs 28 addresses.  
  Design the subblocks for each institute and mention the range of addresses still available after  
  Page #2

these allocations.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
4C)                   Draw the IPV4 header structure, and discuss the details of each field.                                 (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
5A)                   With neat diagram, explain the functions of each field in the TCP header structure.                    (4)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
5B)                   Illustrate with neat diagrams, the sequence of TCP connection establishment and termination.           (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
5C)                   Write the steps that include the functioning of DNS protocol.                                          (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Application"
